21st Payment)", "ExpRsvRem__c": Number (Outstanding Expense/Legal Reserve 100%), "LossRsvRem__c": Number (Outstanding Loss Reserve 100%), "LossAmt__c": Number (Settlement/Indemnity Amount - 100% Basis), "ExpAmt__c": Number (Survey Fees/Expenses -
